packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-03 - unverified image reading (first reader)

Exposure statement: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this record. I read only the brief, PROMPT.md and the image files (and listed the packet directory to get filenames/sizes). I did not open packet.json.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001.jpg, overview of face A)
- Single paper(?) leaf, portrait, upright; lower edge torn/irregular (bottom right cut away diagonally), top right edge slightly torn.
- One column of a cursive documentary hand (Gothic cursiva), c. 26-27 written lines, occupying the upper two-thirds of the leaf; lower third blank.
- Not a literary text: a list of entries, each beginning "It(em)" with a paragraph-like mark, "p(ro) ... vendito/vendita" or "a [name] ...", followed by sums in roman numerals with currency/weight abbreviations (lb./"tt", "gr"?, "duc(atos)?"/"m(a)r(cas)?"). Looks like an account of receipts (sales, payments received).
- No rubrics, no enlarged initials, no running title visible. No interlinear glosses. Faint offset/show-through text at right of the first lines (from the other side or a facing leaf).
- Modern pencil: "(c.1471)" in right margin around line 21; lower right "Stams, StA, Frag. 93.." (shelfmark note). These are modern annotations, not part of the text.
- Overview of face B is image-006.jpg; tiles image-002..005 are presumably face A, image-007..010 face B.

CONVENTIONS USED: "It(em)" = paragraph-mark + "It"; "p(ro)" = p with looped descender; "lb" = the crossed double-l/"tt"-like pound sign (lib(rae)); "gr" = g with r and stroke (gr(ossi)?); "s(i)bi" = long-s + b with stroke. Roman numerals as written (final j). Capital S in this hand is a looped form resembling B (compare "Soma" line 6 and "Sale" line 3).

FACE A - image-002.jpg (top-left tile; right side of lines cut off at tile edge)
002-01  It(em) p(ro) argento vendito ep[...]   (continues off tile)
002-02  lb iij gr ix
002-03  It(em) p(ro) Sale(?) vendito in B[...]   ("Sale" initial is the looped B-like S; could also be read "Bale")
002-04  aur(?)~ xxxxiiij lb xx(?) , gr [...]   (first word: a + u/ir + superscript stroke, expansion uncertain)
002-05  It(em) p(ro) allecib(us) vendit(is) lb[...]
002-06  It(em) p(ro) Soma Canapi ve[...]
002-07  It(em) p(ro) iiij bobus vendit(is) [...]
002-08  It(em) a Joha(n)ne(?) Metzger d(e)(?) [...]   ("Joha" with stroke)
002-09  vendit(is) lb xxxxvj
002-10  It(em). a paulo de Zarn(?)/Zam(?) p[...]
002-11  lb xxxij ung(?) gr ij   ("ung" uncertain: u/v-n/m-g; possibly a unit abbreviation)
002-12  It(em) a Oswaldo kopp(?)/kepp(?) de [...]
002-13  vendita lb xxxiiij
002-14  It(em) a Cunrado Nägelin d[...]   ("Cünrado" with superscript mark over u)
002-15  vini s(i)bi vendit(is) epuss[...]   (word after vendit(is) uncertain, see 003)
002-16  It(em) p(ro) pannis [...]   (bottom edge, partly cut)

FACE A - image-003.jpg (top-right tile; overlaps 002 on the left; line numbering here follows the text lines of this tile, which are the same physical lines as 002-01..15)
003-01  [...]ndito epuissoe(?) d(omi)n(o)(?) aur(?)~ xxx   (= continuation of 002-01. Word after "vendito": letters e-p-u-i-ss-o-e, possibly with abbreviation stroke; I cannot expand it securely. "dm" with stroke over = d(omi)n(o)? Then the same a+u/ir+superscript word as 002-04, then xxx)
003-02  (show-through only; no ink of this side beyond the tile overlap with 002-02)
003-03  [...]to in Glurns et in aliis(?) locis   ("alys" written: a-l-y-s with -s; = aliis)
003-04  [...] lb(?) xx , gr iiij   (= end of 002-04: "aur(?)~ xxxxiiij lb xx , gr iiij")
003-05  [...]ndit(is) lb xxx   (= end of 002-05)
003-06  [...]napi vendito lb iij   (= end of 002-06)
003-07  [...] vendit(is) ad curia(m) p(ri)ncip(is) aur(?)~ xiiij   ("pncips" with abbreviation)
003-08  [...]ger d(e) Vmlist(?)/Vinlist(?) p(ro) trib(us) vaccis(?) s(i)bi   ("vacis"/"vatis": c/t ambiguous)
003-09  [...]xxvj   (= end of 002-09)
003-10  [...]arn(?) p(ro) equa s(i)bi vendita   (= continues 002-10; place name Zarn/Zam: "Zarn" preferred, final stroke group m or rn)
003-11  [...] ij   (= end of 002-11)
003-12  [...] kopp de Talfs(?)/Zalfs(?) p(ro) equa s(i)bi
003-13  [...]iiij   (= end of 002-13)
003-14  [...]ägelin de Siltz(?)/Silz p(ro) trib(us) vrnis
003-15  [...] epuissoe(?) d(omi)n(o)(?) lb xxxviij(?) g(r)(?) [...]   (bottom edge, lower half of letters cut; numerals uncertain)

Joined reading of face A lines 1-15 (from 002+003, overlap reconciled):
A01  It(em) p(ro) argento vendito epuissoe(?) d(omi)n(o)(?) aur(?)~ xxx
A02  lb iij gr ix
A03  It(em) p(ro) Sale(?) vendito in Glurns et in aliis locis
A04  aur(?)~ xxxxiiij lb xx , gr iiij
A05  It(em) p(ro) allecib(us) vendit(is) lb xxx
A06  It(em) p(ro) Soma Canapi vendito lb iij
A07  It(em) p(ro) iiij bobus vendit(is) ad curia(m) p(ri)ncip(is) aur(?)~ xiiij
A08  It(em) a Joha(n)ne(?) Metzger d(e) Vmlist(?) p(ro) trib(us) vaccis(?) s(i)bi
A09  vendit(is) lb xxxxvj
A10  It(em). a paulo de Zarn(?) p(ro) equa s(i)bi vendita
A11  lb xxxij ung(?) gr ij
A12  It(em) a Oswaldo kopp(?) de Talfs(?) p(ro) equa s(i)bi
A13  vendita lb xxxiiij
A14  It(em) a Cunrado Nägelin de Siltz(?) p(ro) trib(us) vrnis
A15  vini s(i)bi vendit(is) epuissoe(?) d(omi)n(o)(?) lb xxxviij(?) gr(?) [...]

FACE A - image-004.jpg (bottom-left tile; lines 004-01..04 overlap A12-A15, not new text)
004-01  It(em) a Oswaldo kopp de [...]   (= A12)
004-02  vendita lb xxxiiij   (= A13; dots over the final iiij)
004-03  It(em) a Cunrado Nägelin d[...]   (= A14; circumflex-like mark over the u of Cunrado)
004-04  vini s(i)bi vendit(is) epussa[...]   (= A15; here the word after vendit(is) looks e-p-u-ss-a/o..., same word as 003-01/003-15)
004-05  It(em) p(ro) pannis lineis(?) et lan[eis?]   ("lineas"/"lineos": final vowel unclear; "lan" then cut)
004-06  famulis annuis(?) ꝯductis (= conductis) et no[n] [...]   ("anuis"/"auuis", 3-4 minims after a)
004-07  It(em) in resignatoe(?) officior(um) [...]   (= "resignac(i)o(n)e"? I see r-e-s-i-g-n-a-t-o-e, likely with an abbreviation I cannot see)
004-08  p(re)sentate(?) sit(?) ind(?)/aio(?) p(ro) domo(?)/domi[...]   (first word: double p-like strokes + "sentate"/"ntate"; "sit" or "sut"; then 3-letter word with minims; "p(ro)" ; "dom" + 3-like sign = dom(us)?)
004-09  It(em) a Datario(?)/Dotario(?) in Kattr[...]
004-10  xx facit aur(?)~ x
004-11  It(em) a pistatore(?) Zwerger(?) f[...]   ("pystatore"; first letter of surname a z-shape with tail, could be "Bw"/"Zw")
004-12  facit lb xxxx
(below: blank to the torn lower edge)

FACE A - image-005.jpg (bottom-right tile; lines 005-01..04 overlap A12-A15)
005-01  [...] kopp de Talfs(?) p(ro) equa s(i)bi   (= A12)
005-02  [...]j   (= end of A13)
005-03  [...]ägelin de Siltz(?) p(ro) trib(us) vrnis   (= A14)
005-04  [...] epussae(?) d(omi)n(o)(?) lb xxxviij(?) gr vj   (= end of A15; here clearly "epussae"/"epussoe" + "dm" with stroke; numeral x-count uncertain, 3 or 4 x)
005-05  [...] et laneis vendit(is) vicinis(?) et   (= continues 004-05)
005-06  [...]is et no(n) ꝯductis (= conductis) aur(?)~ xxxj lb x(?) gr vj   ("no" with stroke = non)
005-07  [...] officior(um) fr(atr)is(?) Joh(ann)is Trient(?)/Triennt(?)   ("fris" with stroke; "Johis" with stroke; surname T-r-i-e-n-t-t/d with superscript stroke)
005-08  [...] domu(s)(?) lb vij , gr vij , q(?) iiij   ("q" with stroke-through = q(uartinos?)/q(uadrantes?), unexpanded)
005-09  [...] Kattinshauser(?)/Kattrnshauser florenos(?) Reinen(ses)(?)   ("floren9" ; "Reinen" with final flourish)
005-10  (nothing on this side of 004-10)
005-11  [...]werger flore(nos) Reinen(ses)(?) vj
Modern pencil: "(c.14?1)" right margin at 005-07 (third digit 4 or 7); "Stams, STA, Frag. 93M"(?) at foot.

Joined reading of face A lines 16-23 (004+005):
A16  It(em) p(ro) pannis lineis(?) et laneis vendit(is) vicinis(?) et
A17  famulis annuis(?) ꝯductis et no(n) ꝯductis aur(?)~ xxxj lb x(?) gr vj
A18  It(em) in resignatoe(?) officior(um) fr(atr)is(?) Joh(ann)is Trient(?)
A19  p(re)sentate(?) sit(?) ind(?) p(ro) domu(s)(?) lb vij , gr vij , q(?) iiij
A20  It(em) a Datario(?) in Kattinshauser(?) florenos(?) Reinen(ses)(?)
A21  xx facit aur(?)~ x
A22  It(em) a pistatore(?) Zwerger(?) flore(nos) Reinen(ses)(?) vj
A23  facit lb xxxx
Face A: all 23 written lines read; nothing left unread. Weakest points: the word after "vendito/venditis" in A01/A15 (epuissoe/epussae), the first word of A04/A07/A17/A21 (a+u/ir+superscript, read aur(?)), A18-A19 opening words, place names (Vmlist, Zarn, Talfs, Siltz, Kattinshauser).

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-006.jpg, overview of face B)
- Same leaf, other side, upright; torn lower edge now at lower right/left mirrored, consistent with the reverse of face A.
- Same hand. 5 entry lines (each "It(em) ..."), then an indented 3-line total block beginning "Suma ..." (written out in words then numerals). Then blank; strong show-through of face A's text (mirror-image) visible over the lower half - not text of this side.
- Modern pencil at foot "Stams, STA, Frag. 93v" and a large pencil mark (looks like "I" + superscript, possibly a numeral) at right; not part of text.
- No rubrics, initials, glosses.

FACE B - image-007.jpg (top-left tile; right side cut; rest is show-through of face A)
007-01  It(em) ab infirmaio(?)/infirmario Laur[...]   ("Infirmaid": i-n-f-r-m-a-i-d/o with an abbreviation over; = infirmario?)
007-02  It(em) a petro Fried(?)/Ried(?) p(ro)[...]
007-03  It(em) a Balthasar p(ro)be[...]/ ple[...]   (word after name begins with p having a stroke through the descender)
007-04  It(em) de Salma(?) et th[...]   ("Salma": looped S as on face A)
007-05  aur(?)~ xx lb viij(?)   (last numeral: v + minims; "viij"/"iiij")
007-06  (indented) Suma o(mn)i(u)m(?) [...]   ("Süma" with mark over u; "om" with stroke = omnium?)
007-07  (indented) marce(?) mill[...]
007-08  (indented) ginta nouem [...]

FACE B - image-008.jpg (top-right tile; overlaps 007 on the left; below line 08 only show-through of face A)
008-01  [...]maid(?) Laurez(?)/Lauret(?) co(n)fessad(?) lb x   (after "infirmaid": "Laurez/Lauret" with long final stroke; then c-o + long-s/f + s-a-d or "cosessad", reading uncertain; then lb x)
008-02  [...]ried p(ro) vno vase vini aur(?)~ xij
008-03  [...]asar p(ro)bendarij(?) vni(?)/vin(?) lb x   ("pbendary" with p-stroke = p(re)bendarii?; short minim word with stroke over, then lb x)
008-04  [...]ma et theolono ad pistrinum
008-05  [...] viiij   (dots over the i's; = end of 007-05, so B05 = aur(?)~ xx lb viiij)
008-06  [...]ma o(mn)i(u)m Receptar(um) p(re)sc(ri)ptar(um)(?)   ("Recepta" + r with stroke; "pscptar" with abbreviation strokes)
008-07  [...]arce(?) Mille Quingente q(ua)dra=
008-08  [...]ta nouem lb vna gr xj(?) q(?) iiij   ("gr" then x/r-like + j: xj or vj; "q" with stroke as in A19)

Joined reading of face B (007+008):
B01  It(em) ab infirmario(?) Laurez(?) co(n)fessad(?) lb x
B02  It(em) a petro Fried(?) p(ro) vno vase vini aur(?)~ xij
B03  It(em) a Balthasar p(ro)bendarij(?) vni(?) lb x
B04  It(em) de Salma(?) et theolono ad pistrinum
B05  aur(?)~ xx lb viiij
B06       Suma o(mn)i(u)m Receptar(um) p(re)sc(ri)ptar(um)(?)
B07       marce(?) Mille Quingente q(ua)dra=
B08       ginta nouem lb vna gr xj(?) q(?) iiij
(B07-B08 hyphenated "q(ua)dra=/ginta". "marce" first letter is a looped capital, read m.)

FACE B - image-009.jpg (bottom-left tile)
No ink of face B in this tile. Only mirror-image show-through of face A's lower entries, a vertical ruling/fold line, horizontal fold, and the modern pencil "Stams, STA[...]". Nothing transcribed.

FACE B - image-010.jpg (bottom-right tile)
No ink of face B. Mirror-image show-through of face A entries (A12-A23) only. Modern pencil "[S]tams, STA, Frag. 93v" and a large pencil mark resembling "I" with superscript "r"/"v" and a vertical stroke (modern; meaning not read). Nothing transcribed.

SUMMARY / LIMITATIONS
- Document type (observation, not identification): a Latin account of receipts in a 15th-century-looking cursive hand (I make no dating claim; the "(c.14?1)" is a modern pencil note on the leaf). Entries list items sold (silver, salt(?), herring, hemp, oxen, cows(?), mares, wine, linen and wool cloth) and payments from named persons and places, with sums in aur(?)~ / lb / gr / q(?) and Rhenish florins(?); face B ends with a total in words: "Suma o(mn)i(u)m Receptar(um) p(re)sc(ri)ptar(um) marce(?) Mille Quingente q(ua)dra/ginta nouem lb vna gr xj(?) q(?) iiij".
- All written text on both faces was read (face A 23 lines, face B 8 lines). Uncertain: the recurring money word read "aur(?)~" (a + u/ir + superscript); "epuissoe/epussae" in A01/A15; opening of A18-A19; "co(n)fessad" in B01; "vni" in B03; several place and personal names.
- A suggested aid for a later check: a higher-contrast crop of A01/A15 word after "vendito" and of A18-A19 left half.
- I did nothing beyond the brief's rules (other than listing the packet directory with sips to get filenames and image sizes). Image limit not reached.
